text: This spot ... many such spots around the earth. On the map detail, see upper left hand corner, Rome, Fort Stanwix, my summer base. This trail, follow the bikepath, up and down, to the creek bed at Sprakers. Stop there to rest. Secret campsite. No one will find you.

**Weather Conditions along the Southern Tier Bike Route (November to February)**

**Temperature**

**New Mexico:** 40-60°F (4-15°C)
**Texas:** 50-70°F (10-21°C)
**Louisiana:** 50-70°F (10-21°C)
**Mississippi:** 40-60°F (4-15°C)
**Alabama:** 40-60°F (4-15°C)
**Florida:** 60-80°F (15-27°C)

**Louisiana:** Average rainfall of 5 inches (127 mm)
**Mississippi:** Average rainfall of 5 inches (127 mm)

**Florida:** Average rainfall of 3 inches (76 mm)
